blocks.name: The leverage line
blocks.plain: One act still moves more than any other, and a fourth session in a row (the launch session of 9/23) opens on it unchanged. BOLO 24 is finished work: the character sheet, the Season 1 beats, the gates table, the slice pipeline, S4-01 rendered, BORESIGHT 24 priced against it. What is left is a date. Name the launch month and four open calls stop being questions, because every one of them is measured from it. Chief's own order puts BOLO 64's four questions first in line; they are quick, and the month comes right behind them.

strand.last: Two sessions landed on 9/20, back to back. The first proved the launch sequence end to end, stood up BOLO 74 (Sensei, the second agent) and BOLO 75 (the Stash deck), and ruled SOP rules 11 and 12. The second ran launch and Sensei in one order, published board v28, queued two goon sets by hand (98 clips, all five-star), and captured BOLO 76 because Sensei talks too much and does not queue the playlists. Two cache notes sat on the rack. Neither session touched the main effort.
strand.plan: Stand the Command up with one word and bring the board to Chief without the main line reading a file.
strand.you: You said 'run launch sequence' at 00:08 on 9/23. Seven stations came up GO: the DARKROOM started fresh in three seconds, JUDY restarted from Bash in eight, Stash was already live and the deck opened, the knobs came up, the wire probed seven of seven, both boards opened. Three specialists ran; the reviewer caught BOLO 76 unplaced and sent it back to WATCH, and this block was written off the digest.
strand.next: Two rulings, in Chief's order: the four questions on BOLO 64 first, then the launch month for BOLO 24, now nineteen days idle. Six older rows in Block V still wait, one since March. BOLO 76 waits on a look at Sensei's queueing, BOLO 71 and 72 on 'go 71' and 'confirm the comp'.

blocks.why: The slice is finished work parked on an unanswered date, and the 9/20 pair proved it a third time: a second agent, a deck, two SOP rules, a launch fix and two goon sets landed in one day, and the main effort did not move. Build capacity is not the constraint; rulings are. One BOLO opened since the last board (76) against none closed, and seven rows in Block V are unchanged for a fifth session, one since March. BOLO 64's four questions sit above it by Chief's word and take minutes. The month is the ruling that releases work already sitting done, and every one of 24's four remaining calls is measured from it.
